committee.sub: Morning brief · Thursday 1 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend fell to $116.33 across 19 clicks (CPC $6.12) from $135.11 and 23 clicks the week before, while conversions stayed at zero. Post-restart clicks sit at 76 of the 150 stop-loss threshold, so the pre-agreed rule hasn't fired yet.

Rank lost share (72.7%) still dwarfs budget lost (22.4%), so the budget conversation stays closed. Impression share sits at 10% with CTR down to 2.4% from 4.6% despite impressions rising to 803 from 495.

The homepage (28 sessions) and /ai-automation-agency.html (17) carry the funnel, but calculator use fell to 0 from 1 the week before even as total sessions held near flat (50 vs 51). Direct sessions jumped to 25 from 13, which reads more like untracked traffic than genuine unpaid demand.

AI Assistant sessions held at 2 for the second week running, all via chatgpt.com, and this figure undercounts because many AI referrals land as Direct with no referrer. LinkedIn sat at 0 versus 1 the week prior, so if Chris posted this week the links were probably untagged. Search Console data through 28 Sept (two days behind) shows organic dropping to 6 sessions from 12, with the integration page ranking at position 14 for 87 impressions but zero clicks.

actions.text: Logo and image assets plus keyword-matched RSA headlines are still outstanding for the serving ad groups, get these finalised.
Fix the homepage form so kontrolTrackLead fires on the Formspree confirm, not before it, so the lead count stops being inflated.
Update RSA description D1, it still claims 13.3 hours of admin per week and needs to match current site stats.
